name: The Fantasticar
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may have The Fantasticar become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Whenever you cast your fourth noncreature spell each turn, you may sacrifice The Fantasticar. If you do, create four 4/4 colorless Construct artifact creature tokens with flying and haste.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast your fourth noncreature spell each turn, you may sacrifice The Fantasticar. If you do, create four 4/4 colorless Construct artifact creature tokens with flying and haste.

needs.what: a 4/4 colorless Construct artifact creature token with flying and haste
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The only Construct in token_ids is construct_0_0_c_artifact_buff (0/0 that grows per artifact, no keywords); the 4/4 flyers (dragon_4_4_r_flying, angel_4_4_w_flying) are colored, non-artifact and lack haste. The trigger itself (spell_cast with nth 4 and a noncreature filter, may sacrifice self, create_token amount 4) and the animate line are otherwise expressible.
